inlines.v: DENUNCIATION, noun 1. Publication; proclamation; annunciation; preaching; as a faithful denunciation of the gospel. 2. Solemn or formal declaration, accompanied with a menace; or the declaration of intended evil; proclamation of a threat; a public menace; as a denunciation of war, or of wrath.
